raw.title: Account Executive (m/w/d) - Enterprise
raw.description:
Introduction

Auf einen Blick

  • 360° Sales mit eigener Pipeline, Fokus auf gehobenen Mittelstand & Enterprise ab 1.000+ Mitarbeitenden
  • OTE 90.000-130.000 €, Split flexibel zwischen 50:50 und 70:30 je nach Erfahrung/Präferenz, Bonus uncapped
  • Klarer Weg zum Senior AE oder in eine Lead-Rolle - wir haben das schon mehrfach gemacht
  • Kunden wie Deutsche Bahn, AOK, ADAC und Rossmann
  • Hybrid: 2–3 Tage Onsite im Office Frankfurt, restliche Tage flexibel im Home Office
  • AI-first: Claude für alle, Freiraum für eigene Automatisierungen in deinem Bereich

About The Role And Potential Progression

__Für wen dieser Job nicht ist__Bevor du weiterliest, kurz und ehrlich:

  • Wenn du Aktivität mit Ergebnis verwechselst (viele Calls, wenig Abschluss), wirst du hier nicht glücklich.
  • Wenn du lieber ein eingespieltes Playbook 1:1 abspulst statt es mitzugestalten, ist das nicht dein Umfeld.
  • Wenn dir Politik, Status und lange Freigabeschleifen wichtig sind, bist du hier falsch - wir sind knapp 50 Leute und entscheiden schnell.

Wenn du bis hier gelesen hast und denkst "genau mein Ding" - weiter geht's.

Worum es geht

Du übernimmst deine eigene Pipeline mit Fokus auf gehobenen Mittelstand und Enterprise ab 1.000+ Mitarbeitenden, führst Deals eigenständig von Discovery bis Abschluss und baust Kundenbeziehungen auf, die über den ersten Vertrag hinaus tragen. Du bekommst kein fertiges Territory ohne Substanz - unsere Kunden sind Namen wie die Deutsche Bahn, AOK, ADAC und Rossmann, und das Thema (Wissen & KI im Unternehmen) hat gerade enormen Rückenwind.

Du arbeitest eng mit Sebastian (Gründer/CEO) und dem Sales-Leadership zusammen: schnelles Feedback, direkte Wege, keine Umwege über drei Ebenen. Das Sales-Team ist mit aktuell 4 Leuten bewusst schlank - du bist keine Nummer in einem großen Vertriebsapparat, sondern siehst direkt, was dein Beitrag bewirkt.

Deine ersten 90 Tage

  • Woche 1: Onboarding in Produkt, ICP, Buying-Center-Logik, CRM/Framework + Shadowing bei Discovery Calls und Demos
  • Ab Woche 2: Erste eigene Discovery Calls + Demos, parallel weiteres Shadowing bei Enterprise-Demos
  • Ab Woche 2/3: Aufbau deiner eigenen Pipeline - du wartest nicht, bis "alles sitzt"
  • Ab Monat 3: Erste eigene, kleinere Deals bis zum Proof of Value

What's in it for you

  • Vergütung: OTE 90.000-130.000 €, je nach Skillset und Seniorität. Der Split zwischen Fix und Bonus liegt flexibel zwischen 50:50 und 70:30 – je nachdem, was zu dir passt. Der Bonus ist uncapped und quartalsweise ausgezahlt.
  • Entwicklungsweg: Konkrete Perspektive auf Senior AE (größere Accounts, höhere Ticketgrößen), Key Account Manager oder Lead-Rolle (Coaching, Teilsegment-Ownership)
  • Direkter Zugang zur Führung: Kurze Wege zu dem Leadership-Team, schnelles Feedback
  • Stabilität ohne Investorendruck: Wir sind profitabel, bootstrapped, wachsen aus eigener Kraft - keine kurzfristige Exit-Logik
  • Namhafte Referenzen: Deutsche Bahn, AOK, ADAC, Rossmann und weitere - du verkaufst mit Substanz, nicht mit Versprechen
  • AI-first ab Tag 1: Wir haben Claude für das ganze Team ausgerollt und setzen es aktiv im Arbeitsalltag ein
  • Choose your own device: Windows oder Mac - deine Entscheidung
  • Arbeitsmodus: Hybrides Modell mit 2–3 Tagen Onsite im Office Frankfurt, restliche Tage flexibel im Home Office

How you can make an impact

  • Pipeline aufbauen: Zielkunden identifizieren, qualifizieren, Dealflow über mehrere Kanäle selbst treiben
  • Enterprise-Discovery führen: Buying Center verstehen, Pain Points rund um Wissen, Enablement und Produktivität herausarbeiten
  • Deals strukturiert steuern: Vom Erstkontakt über Demo, Business Case, Proof of Value bis zur Verhandlung - mit MEDDIC als Werkzeug, nicht als Pflichtübung
  • ROI-Sprache statt Feature-Pitch: Mehrwert auf Business-Ebene argumentieren (Effizienz, Risiko, Wettbewerbsfähigkeit)
  • Feedback an Product & Marketing zurückspielen: Du schärfst aktiv mit an ICP, Messaging und Go-to-Market
  • Nach außen sichtbar sein: Ausgewählte Events, Messen, digitale Formate
  • Daten- statt Bauchgefühl-Vertrieb: Du pflegst dein HubSpot-CRM aktiv und nutzt es als echten Hebel - für saubere Forecasts, klare Priorisierung und Deals, die auf Fakten basieren

Skills to be successful

Must-have:

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B-SaaS-Vertrieb, idealerweise Enterprise oder komplexe Buying-Center
  • Eigenständig Deals von A–Z begleitet und abgeschlossen - mit nachweisbaren Ergebnissen
  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift

Nice-to-have:

  • Erfahrung mit strukturierten Sales-Frameworks (MEDDIC, Challenger, SPICED) - wenn nicht vorhanden, entwickeln wir das mit dir
  • Erfahrung im C-Level-/Bereichsleiter-Umfeld

Mindset, das zu uns passt:

  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Ergebnisse, statt Gründe zu suchen, warum es nicht geklappt hat
  • Du willst in den nächsten 12-18 Monaten eine steile Lernkurve und bist bereit die Extrameile zu gehen
  • Klare Worte sind dir wichtiger als diplomatischer Nebel - auch uns gegenüber
  • Du greifst aktiv zu KI-Tools und baust dir eigene Automatisierungen, die deinen Alltag schneller machen

Your path to Omnora

Damit du weißt, was dich im Bewerbungsprozess erwartet:

  1. Kennenlernen mit unserer Senior Talent Acquisition Managerin
  2. Deep Dive mit dem Fachbereich
  3. Optional: Kennenlernen mit unserem Gründer & CEO
  4. Onsite Assessment inkl. Case Study und Team Meet-Ups

Bewirb dich, wenn du Lust auf echten Impact hast!

title: Marketing Manager (m/w/d)
description: Introduction Du willst nicht einfach Kampagnen abarbeiten sondern Marketing von Grund auf aufbauen? Du denkst in Systemen, hast ein Gespür für Zahlen und weißt gleichzeitig, wie man Botschaften formuliert, die ankommen? Wir sind Omnora, eine B2B SaaS-Company aus Frankfurt. Wir helfen Unternehmen wie DB, AOK und ADAC dabei, ihr Wissen zu sichern, zu strukturieren und nutzbar zu machen - mit KI. Als unser Marketing Manager bist du von Tag 1 an die treibende Kraft hinter unserem gesamten Marketing. Du steuerst Kampagnen über alle Kanäle hinweg, baust unsere Performance-Marketing-Infrastruktur auf und entwickelst Schritt für Schritt eine Struktur, aus der langfristig eine echte Marketingabteilung entsteht. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit dem Management Team zusammen - ohne festgefahrene Prozesse, dafür mit echter Gestaltungsfreiheit. Kurz gesagt: Du bist unser Founding Marketing Manager. Was du hier aufbaust, gehört dir. What's in it for you Founding-Role mit echter Ownership: Du baust nicht in einer Abteilung mit - du baust die Abteilung. Was du hier aufbaust, trägt langfristig deinen Fingerabdruck und bietet dir echte Entwicklungsperspektive in Richtung Marketing Lead. Blitzschnelles Lernen: Du tauchst in alle Disziplinen ein - von Content über Performance bis Automation - und lernst in Monaten, wofür andere Jahre brauchen. Gestaltungsfreiraum: Statt festgefahrener Prozesse erwartet dich maximaler Freiraum, Dinge auszuprobieren. Kurze Wege, großer Einfluss: Du arbeitest eng mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen und siehst, wie deine Arbeit das Unternehmen bewegt. Hybrides Arbeiten: Was zählt, ist dein Beitrag - nicht wo du sitzt. Wir arbeiten hybrid aus Frankfurt mit flexiblen Home-Office-Möglichkeiten. Der perfekte Einstiegszeitpunkt: Mit marktreifem Produkt und starken Referenzen stehen wir vor dem nächsten Wachstumsschritt - der ideale Moment, um einzusteigen und mitzugestalten. How you can make an impact Performance Marketing & Lead Generation: Du planst, steuerst und optimierst Kampagnen auf Google Ads und LinkedIn mit einem klaren Ziel: qualifizierte Leads für unser Sales-Team. CPL, ROAS und Pipeline-Contribution sind deine Währung - nicht nice-to-haves, sondern tägliche Steuerungsgrößen. Account-Based Marketing: Du entwickelst ABM-Kampagnen, die gezielt Enterprise-Accounts in der DACH-Region ansprechen - mit den richtigen Botschaften, zur richtigen Zeit, auf den richtigen Kanälen. Omni-Channel Orchestrierung: Du steuerst alle Marketingkanäle zusammen - Paid, Organic, Content, Email - und sorgst dafür, dass sie als System funktionieren statt als Einzelmaßnahmen nebeneinander zu laufen. Content & Kreation: Du entwickelst Formate und Inhalte, die bei unseren Zielgruppen ankommen, und testest kontinuierlich, was wirklich performt - datenbasiert statt Bauchgefühl. Marketing-Infrastruktur: Du baust eine skalierbare Infrastruktur auf - von HubSpot-Automation über Lead-Tracking bis hin zu verlässlichem Reporting. KI & Automatisierung: Du nutzt aktiv KI-Tools, um Prozesse zu automatisieren - von der Content-Produktion bis hin zu personalisierten Kampagnen. Agentur-Steuerung: Du bist zentraler Ansprechpartner für unsere Marketing-Agentur, briefst Kampagnen, gibst Feedback und stellst sicher, dass Ergebnisse geliefert werden. Sales-Marketing-Alignment: Du bist die aktive Schnittstelle zum Vertrieb und stellst sicher, dass Leads nicht nur generiert, sondern auch konvertiert werden. Skills to be successful Erste echte Berufserfahrung: Du bringst 1-3 Jahre Erfahrung im Marketing mit - idealerweise im B2B SaaS-, Tech- oder Startup-Umfeld. Du hast Kampagnen nicht nur betreut, sondern eigenverantwortlich gesteuert und bist damit auch mal auf die Nase gefallen. Beides ist wertvoll. Akademischer Hintergrund: Abschluss einer Top-Universität oder mit überdurchschnittlichen Noten in Marketing, BWL, Kommunikation o. ä. Performance-Marketing-Kompetenz: Du kennst dich mit Paid Media auf Google und LinkedIn aus, weißt wie man Kampagnen aufsetzt, optimiert und bewertet. Längere Sales-Cycles und komplexe Buying Center sind dir nicht fremd. Zahlenaffinität: Bei uns wird alles gemessen und getrackt. Du scheust dich nicht vor Dashboards und KPIs, sondern nutzt sie als Kompass für deine tägliche Arbeit. Zahlen sind für dich die Basis jeder Entscheidung, nicht lästige Pflicht. HubSpot & Automation: Erfahrung mit HubSpot Marketing Hub - idealerweise inkl. Segmentierung, Automation und Attribution - ist ein klares Plus. KI-Affinität: Du hast Berührungspunkte mit KI-gestützten Tools in der Content-Produktion oder Lead-Generierung und bist neugierig, das weiterzuentwickeln. Kreatives Auge: Du hast ein Gespür für Sprache und Design - für LinkedIn-Posts genauso wie für Kampagnen-Creatives. Erfahrung mit Canva oder Adobe Creative Cloud ist ein Plus. Extreme Ownership: Du brauchst niemanden, der dir sagt was zu tun ist. Wenn du eine Chance siehst, ergreifst du sie. Wenn Hindernisse kommen, überspringst du sie. Du gehst voran. Kommunikation & Kollaboration: Du kommunizierst klar und präzise - intern wie extern, auf Deutsch und Englisch. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

About The Role And Potential Progression

In dieser Rolle bist du vor allem operativ im Vertrieb aktiv: Du identifizierst relevante Accounts, führst Discovery Calls, orchestrierst komplexe Sales-Zyklen und bringst Deals über die Ziellinie.

How you can make an impact

Beginne deine Karriere mit einer tiefgehenden Spezialisierung in Schlüsselbereichen, die für einen Key Account Manager unerlässlich sind, und steuere dann auf eine Rolle mit übergreifender Umsatzverantwortung zu. Einblicke in die kurzfristige Spezialisierung: Vertriebskompetenzen: Vertiefe deine Fähigkeiten im Vertrieb, indem du effektive Verkaufsstrategien und -taktiken erlernst, die auf die Bedürfnisse großer Accounts zugeschnitten sind. Kommunikationsfähigkeiten: Entwickle deine kommunikativen Fähigkeiten weiter, um effektiv mit Kunden zu verhandeln, ihre Bedürfnisse zu verstehen und überzeugende Präsentationen zu halten. Beratungskompetenz: Erweitere deine Beratungsfähigkeiten, um Kundenbedürfnisse zu analysieren und maßgeschneiderte Lösungen zu entwickeln, die den Mehrwert und den Umsatz steigern. Business Case Entwicklung: Lerne, überzeugende Business Cases zu erstellen, die die Vorteile deiner Lösungen klar kommunizieren und intern wie extern verteidigt werden können. Accountanalyse: Vertiefe dein Verständnis für die Analyse von Kundenaccounts, um Potenziale für Upselling und Cross-Selling zu erkennen und zu nutzen. Mittelfristige Entwicklung: Key Account Management: Nachdem du Erfahrung in den oben genannten Bereichen gesammelt hast, steigst du in das Key Account Management auf, wo du strategische Verantwortung für die Betreuung und Entwicklung unserer größten und umsatzstärksten Kunden übernimmst. Deine Aufgabe wird es sein, langfristige Beziehungen zu pflegen und die Umsatzverantwortung für diese wichtigen Accounts zu tragen. Langfristige Karriereperspektiven: Führungspositionen: Langfristig bietet sich die Möglichkeit, in Führungspositionen innerhalb des Vertriebs, des Customer Success oder des Business Development aufzusteigen. What's in it for you Leistungsorientierte Boni: Erhalte quartalsweise ausgeschüttete Boni bei Erreichung deiner Ziele, um deinen Erfolg direkt zu belohnen. Verwirklichung statt politische Entscheidungen: Entfalte dein Potenzial in einer Unternehmenskultur, die Eigenverantwortung schätzt und datengetriebene Entscheidungen fördert. Dynamisches Lernen: Entwickle dich stetig weiter mit Zugang zu Büchern, Coachings und LinkedIn Learning – alles ohne Angst vor Fehlern. Ausgezeichnete Arbeitsumgebung: Als mehrfach ausgezeichnetes Top-Unternehmen bieten wir ein Umfeld, das berufliches Wachstum unterstützt und Wertschätzung garantiert. Flexibilität und Chancengleichheit: Nutze flexible Arbeitsmodelle mit der Möglichkeit zum Homeoffice. Bei uns zählt dein Beitrag, unabhängig von deiner Position. Hundefreundliches Büro: Bringe deinen Hund mit – bei uns sind alle Familienmitglieder willkommen. Gemeinsame Feiern: Erlebe, wie wir Erfolge bei Teamevents, von Sommerfesten bis Weinwanderungen, gemeinsam feiern. How you can make an impact Als Customer Success Manager bist du für das kontinuierliche Account Management, das heißt für die bestmögliche Nutzung und den Kundenumsatz verantwortlich. Deine Hauptaufgaben umfassen: Kontinuierliches Account Management: Durchführung von Jour Fixes zur Analyse der Kundenzufriedenheit, Nutzungsevaluation und aktuellen Herausforderungen. Entwicklung maßgeschneiderter Vorschläge und Kommunikationsstrategien, basierend auf spezifischen Kundenbedürfnissen. Anfertigung von Business Case Narratives zur internen Verteidigung unserer Lösungen. Durchführung kundenübergreifender Webinare und kundenspezifischer Workshops. Management des Sales Cycles: Upselling: Identifizierung zusätzlicher Bedürfnisse im Kundenunternehmen. Retention: Sicherstellung der Kundenbindung und der Vertragsfortsetzung. Netzwerk- und Stakeholder-Management: Ausweitung des Netzwerks innerhalb des Kundenunternehmens durch Identifikation und Ansprache neuer relevanter Ansprechpartner. Skills to be successful Vertriebsorientierung und Vernetzungsfähigkeit: Freude an der Vernetzung mit neuen und bekannten Ansprechpartnern. Außerdem ein Challenger-Mindset, um selbstbewusst und mutig im Umgang mit unseren Kunden zu handeln. Kommunikative Fähigkeiten: Eloquenz und Wortgewandtheit, gepaart mit der Fähigkeit, Kundeninteressen zu verstehen und zu vertreten. Struktur und Genauigkeit: Ein strukturierter Arbeitsansatz und Genauigkeit in allen Aufgabenbereichen, unterstützt durch eine starke Eigenverantwortung und eine datengetriebene Arbeitsweise. Lernbereitschaft: Ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Wirtschaft, Kommunikation, Medien oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung sind wünschenswert. Erfahrungen in den Bereichen Kundenbetreuung, Vertrieb, Marketing, HR oder Consulting sind von Vorteil aber kein Muss. title: Producer Content & Brand Experience (m/w/d)
description: As one of Europe’s most recognized streetwear brands, 6PM stands out not only through our designs and unique vibe, but above all through our community. Whether it’s pop-up tours, our own record label, or collaborations – we don’t just make fashion. We create culture. And now, we’re looking for you! The role holder plans and delivers 6PM's content productions and live brand formats, and manages the external partners required for both. Concept and visual language are owned by Brand. This role is accountable for feasibility, cost, resourcing, scheduling, compliance and delivery. The role exists to consolidate two production disciplines under one owner, from standalone campaign shoots to brand experiences and pop-ups. Tasks Content production (approx. 40%) Translate creative concepts from Brand into production plans, schedules and budgets. Book and manage crew, casting, talent, models, locations, studios and equipment in alignment with Brand and Marketing. Run pre-production, production and post-production through edit, grade, retouch and delivery in the required channel formats. Manage usage rights, buyouts, model releases and music licensing, and maintain the record of what has been licensed for how long. Live formats (approx. 40%) Plan and deliver pop-ups, drop events, PR stunts, community and music formats. Secure locations and contracts; obtain permits and manage official conditions with the relevant authorities. Select, contract and manage suppliers across set build, technical production, security, catering and logistics. Prepare risk assessments and implement safety concepts, including capacity limits, queue management, escape routes, stewarding and the emergency escalation chain. Manage run of show, talent and VIP handling, load-out and reinstatement. Integration of content and live (approx. 10%) Plan content capture into every live format at concept stage, including shot list, camera positions and lighting. Coordinate capture crew and same-day or next-day asset delivery with Social and Brand. Operations and partner management (approx. 10%) Maintain the production calendar with milestones, lead times and points of no return, and feed it into the marketing calendar. Build and maintain the freelancer and supplier bench, including rate cards and framework agreements. Control production budgets, track committed versus actual spend, and report variances to the Head of Marketing. Conduct a written debrief after each production covering cost, timing and learnings, and update standard lead times accordingly. Weightings are indicative and shift with the seasonal calendar. Requirements Essential 4 to 6 years in production, with demonstrable work on both content productions and live formats. Background in fashion, streetwear, music, entertainment or sport. Independent budget responsibility: builds production budgets, tracks them and delivers close to plan. Established supplier and freelancer network in DACH across both content and live. Manages risk assessments and implements safety concepts: capacity, queue management, escape routes, stewarding, escalation chain. Working knowledge of permit processes with German municipal authorities, including realistic processing times. Experience with talent, artists, agencies and VIPs, including riders, advancing and usage rights. Understanding of streetwear, fashion and music, and of the 6PM community. Willingness to escalate and to stop a format on safety or feasibility grounds. German fluent, English confident. Preferred Drops and queue management, store openings or retail, festival or club production. Post-production supervision. Agency production background. Productions outside DACH. Vocational qualification in event management (Veranstaltungskaufmann/-frau, Veranstaltungsfachwirt IHK) or equivalent production training. Formal education is not a selection criterion. As one of Europe’s most recognized streetwear brands, 6PM stands out not only through our designs and unique vibe, but above all through our community. Whether it’s pop-up tours, our own record label, or collaborations – we don’t just make fashion. We create culture.

And now, we’re looking for you!

The role holder plans and delivers 6PM's content productions and live brand formats,

and manages the external partners required for both. Concept and visual language are

owned by Brand. This role is accountable for feasibility, cost, resourcing, scheduling,

compliance and delivery.

The role exists to consolidate two production disciplines under one owner, from

standalone campaign shoots to brand experiences and pop-ups.

Tasks

Content production (approx. 40%)

  • Translate creative concepts from Brand into production plans, schedules and budgets.
  • Book and manage crew, casting, talent, models, locations, studios and equipment in alignment with Brand and Marketing.
  • Run pre-production, production and post-production through edit, grade, retouch and delivery in the required channel formats.
  • Manage usage rights, buyouts, model releases and music licensing, and maintain the record of what has been licensed for how long.

Live formats (approx. 40%)

  • Plan and deliver pop-ups, drop events, PR stunts, community and music formats.
  • Secure locations and contracts; obtain permits and manage official conditions with the relevant authorities.
  • Select, contract and manage suppliers across set build, technical production, security, catering and logistics.
  • Prepare risk assessments and implement safety concepts, including capacity limits, queue management, escape routes, stewarding and the emergency escalation chain.
  • Manage run of show, talent and VIP handling, load-out and reinstatement.

Integration of content and live (approx. 10%)

  • Plan content capture into every live format at concept stage, including shot list, camera positions and lighting.
  • Coordinate capture crew and same-day or next-day asset delivery with Social and Brand.

Operations and partner management (approx. 10%)

  • Maintain the production calendar with milestones, lead times and points of no return, and feed it into the marketing calendar.
  • Build and maintain the freelancer and supplier bench, including rate cards and framework agreements.
  • Control production budgets, track committed versus actual spend, and report variances to the Head of Marketing.
  • Conduct a written debrief after each production covering cost, timing and learnings, and update standard lead times accordingly.

Weightings are indicative and shift with the seasonal calendar.

Requirements

Essential

  • 4 to 6 years in production, with demonstrable work on both content productions and live formats.
  • Background in fashion, streetwear, music, entertainment or sport.
  • Independent budget responsibility: builds production budgets, tracks them and delivers close to plan.
  • Established supplier and freelancer network in DACH across both content and live.
  • Manages risk assessments and implements safety concepts: capacity, queue management, escape routes, stewarding, escalation chain.
  • Working knowledge of permit processes with German municipal authorities, including realistic processing times.
  • Experience with talent, artists, agencies and VIPs, including riders, advancing and usage rights.
  • Understanding of streetwear, fashion and music, and of the 6PM community.
  • Willingness to escalate and to stop a format on safety or feasibility grounds.
  • German fluent, English confident.

Preferred

  • Drops and queue management, store openings or retail, festival or club production.
  • Post-production supervision.
  • Agency production background.
  • Productions outside DACH.
  • Vocational qualification in event management (Veranstaltungskaufmann/-frau, Veranstaltungsfachwirt IHK) or equivalent production training.

Formal education is not a selection criterion. Assessment is based on delivered

productions.

Benefits

  • Modern office in Berlin, complimentary drinks & work-from-home Fridays
  • Contribution towards a gym membership as well as various mobility benefits
  • Individual training and development opportunities to support your professional and personal growth
  • Regular team events and incentives
  • Flexible working hours based on trust within a young, motivated team
  • Attractive salary package with a variable compensation component

Want to be a part of 6PM? We'd love to hear from you!

title: Werkstudent:in digitales Produktmanagement (w/m/d)
description: Pflegehelden® Franchise GmbH Die Pflegehelden sind marktführender Vermittler von Betreuungskräften in deutsche Privathaushalte. Mit der sogenannten 24-Stunden-Betreuung ermöglichen wir Seniorinnen und Senioren die ganzheitliche Betreuung und Pflege in ihrem gewohnten Umfeld zuhause. Aufgaben Als Werkstudent:in im digitalen Produktmanagement arbeitest du an den verschiedenen digitalen Produkten und Zukunftsthemen der Pflegehelden. Dazu gehören unser eigenentwickeltes CRM, der Heldenplaner, sowie unsere App und das Support-Ticketsystem. Außerdem beschäftigen wir uns intensiv damit, wie wir bestehende Prozesse mithilfe von KI vereinfachen und verbessern können. Der Heldenplaner bildet den gesamten Vermittlungsprozess ab und wird täglich von unseren Franchise-Partner:innen, Vermittlungsagenturen und Mitarbeitenden genutzt. Du unterstützt die Head of Product und das Entwicklungsteam über den gesamten Produktprozess hinweg, von der ersten Idee und der Analyse bestehender Abläufe bis zum erfolgreichen Einsatz neuer Funktionen. Was dich bei uns konkret erwartet: Du testest neue Funktionen im Heldenplaner und in der App, dokumentierst die Ergebnisse und unterstützt bei der fachlichen Abnahme. Du bearbeitest Supportanfragen aus unserem Ticketsystem, klärst Anliegen mit unseren Nutzer:innen und erkennst wiederkehrende Fragen / Probleme. Daraus leitest du Verbesserungen für unsere Produkte und Prozesse ab. Du formulierst verständliche Entwicklungstickets, ergänzt Akzeptanzkriterien und klärst offene fachliche Fragen. Du unterstützt bei Recherchen, Konzepten und einfachen Prototypen. Dabei erprobst du unter anderem, wie wir Prozesse mithilfe von KI effizienter gestalten können. Du unterstützt uns dabei, Produkt-, Nutzungs- und Prozessdaten aufzubereiten und auszuwerten. Dabei wirkst du an Dashboards und Analysen in Power BI mit und hilfst uns, datenbasierte Erkenntnisse für unsere Produkte abzuleiten. Du begleitest Rollouts und erstellst verständliche Anleitungen, Release-Informationen und Schulungsunterlagen. Du übernimmst schrittweise eigene Themen und hältst Vereinbarungen sowie offene Aufgaben zuverlässig nach. Deine Aufgaben sind bewusst vielseitig. Durch Datenanalyse, Qualitätssicherung und den direkten Austausch mit unseren Nutzer:innen lernst du unsere Produkte kennen. Gleichzeitig erhältst du Einblicke in verschiedene Bereiche moderner Produktarbeit und kannst diese aktiv mitgestalten. Qualifikation Du bist an einer Hochschule oder Universität eingeschrieben, beispielsweise in Medienmanagement, (Wirtschafts-) Informatik, BWL oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang. Du interessierst dich dafür, wie digitale Produkte entstehen und wie aus einem echten Nutzer:innenproblem eine gute Lösung wird. Du hast Interesse an Datenanalyse und bringst Erfahrungen mit Excel mit. Kenntnisse in Power BI sind ein Plus. Du kannst komplexe Sachverhalte strukturiert erfassen und verständlich formulieren und arbeitest sorgfältig. Du fragst nach, wenn etwas unklar ist, und wartest nicht darauf, dass dir jeder nächste Schritt vorgegeben wird. Du arbeitest gern mit unterschiedlichen Menschen zusammen, darunter Entwickler:innen und unsere Franchise-Partner:innen. Du bist neugierig, stellst den Status quo konstruktiv infrage und möchtest Verantwortung übernehmen. Erste Erfahrungen mit Tools wie Miro oder Figma sowie im Produkt- oder Projektmanagement, User Research, Datenanalyse oder Softwareentwicklung sind ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung. Wichtiger sind uns deine Lernbereitschaft, dein strukturiertes Denken und deine Zuverlässigkeit. Benefits Eine sinnstiftende Aufgabe: Unsere digitalen Produkte unterstützen Menschen dabei, möglichst lange in ihrem eigenen Zuhause leben zu können. Ein kleines, motiviertes Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und direktem Kontakt zur Head of Product. Ein vielseitiger Einblick in Produktstrategie, Discovery, Softwareentwicklung, Testing, Rollout und Produktbetrieb. Schrittweise wachsende Verantwortung für eigene Themen. Raum, neue Technologien und KI-Werkzeuge praktisch auszuprobieren. Eine Vergütung von 15€ pro Stunde mit der Perspektive einer Anpassung bei wachsender Erfahrung und Verantwortung. Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit 15 bis 20 Wochenstunden, die sich mit deinem Studium vereinbaren lassen. In der vorlesungsfreien Zeit kannst du nach Absprache auch mehr arbeiten. Ein moderner Arbeitsplatz nahe des Hamburger Hauptbahnhofs. Eine langfristige Perspektive und die Möglichkeit, dich bei uns weiterzuentwickeln, wenn es für beide Seiten passt. Interesse? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams und gestalte mit uns die digitalen Produkte hinter Pflegehelden®. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung und darauf, dich kennenzulernen! Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

ownership once the customer is stable and the learning can be reused.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Product contribution</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Contribute production-quality Engineering, Field, and Customer Success teams to turn AI adoption learning into reusable guidance and product improvements.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Thought leadership</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Create title: Working Student/Intern - Marketing
description: At justDice, we create mobile gaming experiences that reward players for their time and engagement. We move quickly, take ownership, and value people who bring ideas, curiosity, and a willingness to challenge how we do things. You’ll work with experienced teammates, solve meaningful problems, and have the freedom to make an impact from day one. Wir sind der europäische Marktführer im Bereich App-Discovery und Mobile Gaming. Mit einer Reichweite von Millionen an Nutzer:innen weltweit entwickeln, erwerben und skalieren wir Tech-Produkte, die begeistern. Wir arbeiten mit hoher Autonomie, hohem Tempo und ohne unnötigen Schnickschnack. Wenn du ein Konzernumfeld mit endlosen Freigabeschleifen suchst, bist du hier falsch. Wenn du Verantwortung übernehmen, mutige Ideen testen und deine Karriere in Marketing durchstarten möchtest, dann willkommen zu Hause! Wir suchen eine/n energiegeladen/n Werkstudenten/in oder Praktikanten/in (m/w/d) zur Unterstützung unseres Marketing Teams in den Bereichen Organic Content, Performance Marketing, SEO und Influencer Marketing. Deine Mission Organic & Social Growth: Erstelle frischen, trendbewussten Content für unsere Social-Media-Plattformen. Du weißt genau, was auf TikTok, Instagram und YouTube funktioniert – und stehst vielleicht sogar selbst für unsere eigenen Kampagnen vor der Kamera. Influencer & Campaign Marketing: Arbeite eng mit dem Team zusammen, um die Kommunikation mit unseren Influencer-Agenturen zu steuern; wähle Top-Creator aus, gib Content frei, evaluiere die Kampagnen Performance und skaliere diesen Kanal. App Store & SEO Operations: Unterstütze das Team bei der App Store Optimierung (ASO) und Suchmaschinenoptimierung (SEO), damit unsere Produkte auf Platz 1 ranken. Employer Branding: Shape zusammen mit dem Team unsere Homepage-Botschaften, erstelle ansprechenden Brand-Content und erwecke unsere Unternehmenskultur zum Leben. Performance Marketing: Hilf beim Erstellen, Tracking und Optimieren von bezahlten Werbekampagnen – und verbinde dabei dein kreatives Gespür mit scharfer Analytik. Dein Profil Fließend in Englisch & Deutsch: Beide Sprachen sollten sicher in Wort und Schrift beherrscht werden. Social Media Native: Du lebst und atmest aktuelle Trends, Memes und Plattform-Formate. Ein eigener Social-Media-Kanal mit ein paar tausend Followern ist ein großes Plus! Erste Erfahrungen: Vorherige Erfahrungen aus einem Marketing-Praktikum, einer Werkstudententätigkeit oder einem Side-Hustle sind ein großer Vorteil. Ausgewogene Denkweise: Du bist hochkreativ, aber gleichzeitig analytisch genug, um Daten zu verstehen und zu erkennen, was die Performance treibt. Drive & Energie: Proaktiv, lernhungrig und bereit, vom ersten Tag an Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Standort & Verfügbarkeit: Wohnsitz in Hamburg oder Umgebung; verfügbar für 2,5 Tage pro Woche (Werkstudent/in) oder in Vollzeit (Praktikum). Bevorzugte Arbeitstage: Montag, Dienstag und Donnerstag. Benefits & Vorteile Investiere in deine Zukunft: Regelmäßiges Feedback und unser Entwicklungsprogramm unterstützen dein Wachstum und helfen dir dabei, dein Skillset zu erweitern und deine Karriereziele zu erreichen. Wohlfühlen am Arbeitsplatz: Genieße den Blick auf die Alster aus unserem zentralen Büro mit erstklassiger Ausstattung, coolen Open Spaces und einer großen Auswahl an Snacks und Getränken. Werde Teil der Community: Nimm an regelmäßigen Team- und Unternehmensevents teil, darunter Hackathons und Social Gatherings. Wir arbeiten nicht nur zusammen – wir feiern auch zusammen! Bereit für das nächste Level? Bewirb dich jetzt und vergiss nicht, Links zu deinen Social-Media-Profilen oder deinem Portfolio beizufügen! At justDice, we value ownership, honesty, collaboration, and having fun while building something ambitious together. We care about hiring great people, not perfect CVs. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who combines deep technical expertise with strong commercial judgement and can apply both to Monzo’s most important and complex challenges.</p> <p>At Monzo, we’re building a bank that is fair, transparent and a delight to use. We’re growing extremely fast and have over 11 million customers in the UK. We’ve built a product that people love and more than 80% of our growth comes from word of mouth and referrals.</p> <p><em>Enable Monzo to Make Better Decisions, Faster</em></p> <p>We have a strong culture of data-driven decision making across the whole company. And we’re great believers in powerful, real-time analytics and empowerment of the wider business. All our data lives in one place and is super easy to use. 90% of day-to-day data-driven decisions are covered by self-serve analytics through Looker, which gives data scientists the headspace to focus on more impactful business questions and analyses.</p> <p>As a Staff Data Scientist, you’ll lead efforts on strategically important, business-critical problems. You’ll be a trusted technical partner to senior leaders, raise the bar for Data Science across Monzo, and build capability in others through coaching, reusable approaches and clear standards.</p> <h4><strong>Our Data Science team ⭐</strong></h4> <p>We are excited to be expanding and are hiring across our Data Science teams. and commercial goals to a clear portfolio of high-impact Data Science work</li> <li>Identify, frame and lead strategically important problems where the path is ambiguous, dependencies span teams, and exploring complex data, designing analyses and experiments, building models or prototypes, and resolving the hardest technical questions</li> <li>Steward critical data products and initiatives end-to-end, ensuring they are robust, well-governed, clearly documented and adopted by the people who need them</li> <li>Balance pace and analytical rigour, making pragmatic trade-offs while thoughtful challenge</li> <li>Coach and mentor data scientists and analytics engineers, using live projects and wider discipline initiatives to build sustainable capability beyond your own individual output</li> </ul> <h4><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></h4> <ul> <li>You have an exceptional track record of leading complex, business-critical Data Science work from ambiguous problem framing through to measurable outcomes</li> <li>You have shaped strategy across a large product or business domain and can influence senior leaders through clear, independent judgement</li> title: Senior Product Data Analyst- Consumer Growth
description: <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>SumUp is best known for helping small businesses get paid — our Consumer tribe builds the other half of that story. We make SumUp Consumer, the wallet app that lets everyday consumers pay SumUp merchants with a tap, send money to friends, track their spending and earn loyalty rewards along the way.</p> <p>As we grow SumUp Consumer across new markets and features, we need sharp, reliable insight into how people discover, adopt and use the product — and how that behaviour translates into sustainable commercial growth. This includes understanding our acquisition funnel, improving activation and conversion, increasing customer value, and reducing churn.</p> <p>We’re looking for a Product Data Analyst to join the Consumer tribe and become the analytical partner for SumUp Consumer. You’ll work closely with Product Managers, Designers and Engineers, alongside our Analytics Engineering team, to understand customer behaviour, shape product strategy, and connect product performance to business outcomes.</p> <p>You’ll help answer questions such as:</p> <ul> <li>Which acquisition channels and customer segments generate the strongest long-term value?</li> <li>Where do customers drop out of the journey from acquisition to activation?</li> <li>What drives repeat usage, retention and churn?</li> <li>Which product changes improve conversion, customer value or commercial performance?</li> <li>How should we prioritise product investments across markets and customer segments?</li> </ul> <p>If you’re motivated by meaningful analytical work, enjoy translating complexity into clarity, and want to see your insights directly influence both product decisions and commercial outcomes, this role is for you.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Analyse customer behaviour and product performance across the full consumer lifecycle — from <strong>acquisition and activation through engagement, retention, churn and reactivation</strong>.</li> <li>Identify opportunities to improve conversion, customer value and sustainable growth using funnel analysis, cohort analysis, segmentation and behavioural analytics.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, Engineers and Data teams to ensure decisions are grounded in robust analysis, customer insight and commercial understanding.</li> <li>Evaluate the performance of customer segments, markets, channels and product journeys, helping the team understand where growth opportunities and commercial trade-offs exist.</li> <li>Support decisions that improve key business outcomes, such as activation, conversion, repeat usage, retention, churn, customer lifetime value and revenue-related metrics.</li> <li>Conduct exploratory analysis to answer product and business questions, translating complex data into clear, commercially relevant recommendations.</li> <li>Define, monitor and communicate core SumUp Consumer KPIs, covering acquisition, activation, engagement, conversion, retention, churn and customer value.</li> <li>Design, execute and analyse A/B tests and product experiments, assessing both customer impact and commercial impact.</li> <li>Build and maintain dashboards and reporting that stakeholders actively use, proactively surfacing trends, anomalies, performance risks and growth opportunities.</li> <li>Help Product Managers assess the expected impact of opportunities and evaluate whether product investments are delivering the intended customer and business outcomes.</li> <li>Partner with Analytics Engineering to ensure KPI definitions, business logic and product instrumentation are accurate, scalable and trusted.</li> <li>Bring a curious eye to AI and machine learning techniques, including LLM-assisted analysis, to speed up insight generation, customer understanding and product measurement.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>You’ll be great for this role if…</strong></h2> <ul> <li>You have strong SQL skills and are comfortable querying, analysing and validating data in a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake, BigQuery or similar.</li> <li>You have hands-on experience with product analytics techniques such as funnel analysis, cohort analysis, segmentation and behavioural analysis.</li> <li>You understand the commercial drivers of a digital product, including customer acquisition, conversion, activation, retention, churn and customer lifetime value.</li> <li>You can connect customer behaviour and product performance to business outcomes, and use data to identify growth opportunities and inform You'll own features from start to finish: scoping the problem, directing the build through to deployment, and iterating based on what you learn. You'll also contribute to discovery and ideation, and work alongside designers and engineers to identify, prioritise, and solve problems efficiently. If you love autonomy, are naturally curious, and want to have a genuine impact within a growing company, we think you'd fit right in! Here’s what you can expect to be working on as a Senior Software Engineer (L5) at Street Group Owning your area of the codebase and its direction: scoping ambiguous problems end-to-end and building with distributed systems and scale in mind. Directing parallel agent sessions to deliver work, while your own attention goes on the design decisions, reviews and complex problems where your judgement is required. Playing an active role in the department's big technical moves: security work, architectural changes, and platform upgrades. Building and improving the team's AI infrastructure beyond your own work - shared plugin skills and the review and CI loops the whole team relies on. Bringing product thinking into everything you build: understanding the user and commercial problem behind the brief, challenging requirements that don't serve the outcome, and being a regular technical voice in discovery alongside product and design. Mentoring less experienced engineers and holding the team's output to a high standard by showing others how to reach it. Work closely with technical leaders and Product Designers to offer technical input; paying special attention to scale, maintainability and alignment. A bit about you You have commercial experience with PHP and Laravel (or a similar MVC framework) - we're less fussed about deep Laravel internals than about solid MVC fundamentals and framework concepts. You have experience working with Vue 3, React, Angular, or similar modern JS framework You have production experience with AWS. ECS, Lambda, SQS, EventBridge and RDS are advantageous. You work AI-natively as a default, using tools like Claude Code, plugins and skills fluently. You design solutions built for scale with little to no support - you know intuitively where performance and load will bite, and just as importantly, when early optimisation isn't worth it. You understand what you're building and why - product thinking is part of the job for you. You're a great communicator with strong attention to detail, and you're comfortable influencing beyond your own team. description: <h2>About Scale</h2> <p>Scale builds AI systems for decisions that matter. We started out providing the data and evaluation behind many of the world's leading models, and we still work with the major frontier labs on research and post-training. Today we also build full applications: we take an organisation's own data and expertise, forward deploy alongside their teams, and build the systems they come to rely on, powered by the Scale GenAI Platform.</p> <h2>The Role</h2> <p>Defence is under pressure to adopt AI at pace. The 2025 Strategic Defence Review and the Defence AI Strategy push for AI to move from experiment to operational capability, Defence Digital and UK Strategic Command are driving digital and data programmes across the department, and the enabling organisations are being asked to field reliable systems, not pilots. Scale wants to play a foundational role in building the dependable AI applications that shift depends on.</p> <p>We're looking for someone to lead that work across UK defence and the national security community. You'd own our commercial relationships across the Ministry of Defence and its enabling organisations - Defence Digital, UK Strategic Command, DE&amp;S, and Dstl - and the broader defence and security customer base.</p> <p>This is a critical role reporting directly to the new Public Sector leader. You'd carry a number, win deals yourself, and build a small team behind you as the work grows. It suits someone who has sold into defence before and knows how it actually makes decisions, not just how the org charts look.</p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li>Own our commercial plan and pipeline for UK defence and security</li> <li>Find, shape, and close deals yourself, from the first conversation through to contract and into delivery</li> <li>Use the relationships you already have across the MOD, Defence Digital, UK Strategic Command, DE&amp;S, Dstl, and the security and intelligence community</li> <li>Work the defence routes to market, and know which are worth the effort and which aren't (the Defence Sourcing Portal, DASA, JOSCAR registration, single-source arrangements, and the main CCS frameworks)</li> <li>Be a credible counterpart to senior military and civil service leaders, and turn what they need into work we can actually deliver</li> <li>Navigate the security clearance, accreditation, and information-handling requirements that come with defence work</li> <li>Stay close to our product and delivery teams so what we sell is what we build</li> <li>Hire and lead a small team over time, and help shape the wider UK public sector plan as a team with the Central Government Lead and Public Sector leader.</li> </ul> <h2>What we're looking for</h2> <ul> <li>You've sold and delivered technology or transformation work into UK defence or national security, either from a vendor or SI or from inside the MOD or the Armed Forces</li> <li>You know at least one part of defence well (MOD, UK Strategic Command, DE&amp;S, Dstl, or a single Service) and how it buys</li> <li>You understand defence and public sector procurement: frameworks, tenders, single-source rules, and buying that runs through a lot of stakeholders</li> <li>You've opened doors, run complex pursuits, and owned the result</li> <li>You have relationships with senior people in defence</li> <li>You hold, or are eligible to obtain, UK security clearance (SC as a minimum; DV desirable)</li> <li>You do your best work when things are ambiguous and moving quickly</li> </ul> <p>People who tend to fit this have spent years leading UK defence work at companies like Palantir, Anduril, BAE Systems, QinetiQ, Leidos or Babcock, at consultancies and systems integrators like Accenture, Deloitte, EY or PA Consulting, or in senior commercial or programme roles inside the MOD, DE&amp;S, or the Armed Forces.</p> <h2>Nice to have</h2> <ul> <li>Experience with AI or data-heavy platforms</li> <li>Regulated, mission-critical, or classified government programmes</li> <li>You've built or run a small commercial team before</li> </ul> <h2>Why join</h2> <p>You'd be building this market, not maintaining it. There's no playbook to inherit, which is rather the point. The deals you win, and the way you win them, will shape how Scale works with UK defence for years.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong><em>PLEASE NOTE:&nbsp;</em></strong><em>Our policy requires a 90-day waiting period before reconsidering candidates for the same role. This allows us to ensure a fair and thorough evaluation of all applicants.</em></p> <p><strong>About Us:</strong></p> <p><em>At Scale, our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions. Cloud Infrastructure is part of Zopa’s Platform Tribe, working alongside DBA and DevX colleagues. Our customers are the engineers who build Zopa’s products, and we are making it easier for them to deliver safely and independently. 
 
In the near term, the team is completing a major migration. Beyond that, we are bringing platform capabilities together and creating more self-service tooling and clear engineering guardrails. 
 
You will join early enough to make a tangible contribution to how the platform evolves, not simply maintain what already exists. 

A Day In The Life:

  • Own delivery of meaningful cloud infrastructure and migration work. 

  • Build and improve infrastructure-as-code, containers and cloud automation. 

  • Work with engineers to understand needs and improve the developer experience. 

  • Help make platform services secure, reliable, observable and maintainable. 

  • Learn and apply Zopa’s AWS, Kubernetes and CI/CD patterns. 

  • Contribute to shared standards, documentation, code review and continuous improvement. 

  • Support business-critical services through the shared on-call rota. 


About You:

  • Practical cloud experience in AWS, GCP, Azure or another major cloud environment. 

  • Container experience, such as Kubernetes or ECS. 

  • Infrastructure-as-code experience, ideally Terraform or a comparable tool. 

  • Experience contributing to CI/CD and reliable software delivery. 

  • Ability to take ownership of a project with support and work through ambiguity. 

  • A collaborative approach to enabling application engineers and improving their experience. 

  • Evidence of quality thinking across reliability, maintainability, security and operational readiness. 

  • Experience participating in an on-call rota or supporting production services. 


Added Bonus:

  • AWS experience and exposure to Kubernetes/EKS, Terraform, Helm and GitHub Actions. 

  • Experience with service discovery, secrets management, networking, monitoring or scripting. 

  • Observability tooling such as Honeycomb, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Splunk. 

  • Pragmatic use of AI-assisted engineering tools. 

#LI-AP1

At Zopa we value flexible ways of working.
We value face-to-face collaboration and a good work-life balance. This hybrid role requires you to come to our Manchester office 2-3 days a week. (WeWork, Dalton Place, 29 John Dalton Street, M2 6WF) Please note this office is dog friendly so you might see some furry friends about!
 
You'll also have the option of working from abroad for up to 120 days a year!* But no matter where you are, we’ll make sure you’ve got everything you need to thrive, both in your work and home life, from day one.
 
*Subject to having the right to work in the country of choice
 
Diversity Statement 
Zopa is proud to offer a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and backgrounds leads to better products for our customers and a unique company culture for our people. We are made up of nearly 50 nationalities, have a DE&I forum made up of Zopians wanting to make a difference and we are proud of our culture where everyone can bring their full self to work. Our approach to DE&I is reflected in our hiring process so please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments. 
 

Our approach to AI in interviews

At Zopa, AI isn't something we're testing out — it's part of how we work every day. As a proud partner of Jobs 2030, we're committed to building AI fluency across our workforce, and we expect Zopians to use AI as part of how they do their jobs. 

Because of that, we want to be transparent about how we think about AI use during our hiring process. 

Behavioural and competency-based interviews: please don't use AI. These conversations are designed to understand you — your experiences, your judgment, and how you've approached real situations. An AI-generated answer can't tell us that. What it can do is get in the way of us finding out whether we're the right fit for each other. 

Technical interviews: it depends on the role. Some technical stages actively welcome AI use, others don't. Your Talent Partner will let you know what's expected at each stage. Where AI is part of the assessment, we'll be interested not just in the outcome, but in how you used it – the tools you chose, your reasoning, and the decisions you made along the way.

Role:   Sales Director   

Location:  London, United Kingdom (2-3 days a week from our london offices)

About the role: 

This is a senior sales role that requires you to achieve your own sales targets as well as motivate, train, nurture and develop a team of sales executives. It is a multiskilled role that requires you to be able to sell - and manage and coach the team to deliver on their individual sales targets that contribute to the overall team target. 

What you will be doing: 

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of sales executives — supporting individual deal progression, building their skills, and holding each person accountable to their target
  • Build a team environment characterised by trust, open communication, and structured accountability — where performance is tracked clearly and support is available when it's needed
  • Own the sales executives' training programme — ensuring the team is fluent in  sales stories, the business development process, RFP and design standards, and the tools and techniques that support consistent delivery
  • Ensure every team member has the education, training, and access to resources needed to operate independently and effectively
  • Run weekly 30-minute progress meetings with each team member — enabling the salesperson to minute and set SMART objectives
  • Contribute actively to the recruitment process for new sales executives
  • Carry and deliver your own individual sales target
  • Take full accountability for the team's collective sales performance — monitoring individual and group targets weekly, monthly, and quarterly via Salesforce
  • Track and report on team KPIs — including call volumes, meeting volumes, pipeline opportunities, RFPs, deals won, and pipeline growth and contraction — and take corrective action where performance falls short
  • Monitor performance against established success criteria; escalate risks and opportunities to the Director of Sales with clear data and a recommended course of action
  • Develop a thorough understanding of the sales cycles and stages — knowing when and how to intervene to support deal progression at the right moment
  • Attend weekly progress meetings with the Director of Sales with SMART objectives prepared and an accurate picture of team performance
  • Provide active support through the RFP, pitch, and bid process — contributing directly to key proposals and ensuring the team has the right support on complex opportunities
  • Work with the Marketing team on ABM programmes and lead generation activities to build and sustain a healthy, qualified pipeline
  • Identify opportunities to improve the team's ways of working — bringing forward recommendations on process, tooling, and methodology within the established sales framework

What you need to be great in this role: 

  • A strong track record of meeting and exceeding personal sales targets in a B2B environment, with demonstrable experience selling complex, consultative propositions to senior marketing, procurement, or C-suite stakeholders
  • Proven experience leading a sales team — coaching individuals to improve performance, managing to targets, and building a culture of accountability and continuous development
  • Deep familiarity with structured sales methodologies and pipeline management; confident working within a defined sales process and holding others to it
  • Proficiency with Salesforce or equivalent CRM platforms — using pipeline data to track performance, identify trends, and make informed decisions
  • Experience supporting or leading RFP, pitch, and bid processes on complex, high-value opportunities
  • Clear, credible written and verbal communication — able to represent OLIVER persuasively at senior client level and articulate the value of a complex service proposition with authority
  • Experience in or close to a creative agency, marketing services, or in-house agency environment is an advantage
  • Track record of delivering against individual and team revenue targets with full transparency to senior leadership on pipeline health, forecast accuracy, and performance against plan
  • Experience collaborating with Marketing on ABM and lead generation programmes — with a clear understanding of how pipeline generation and sales conversion interact commercially
  • Confidence presenting commercial performance and forecasts to director-level stakeholders, with a track record of identifying and acting on the levers that protect and grow revenue
  • Strategic integration of AI across sales operations — including prospecting, proposal development, pipeline analysis, CRM hygiene, and performance reporting
  • Experience setting standards and governance for AI tool use within a sales team, ensuring outputs are accurate, on-brand, and commercially sound before they reach clients
  • Agentic leadership for complex business development challenges — systematic, goal-oriented approach to pipeline strategy, deal management, and team performance
  • Drives AI adoption and shares best practice across the team and wider OLIVER network, contributing to how the business develops its sales capability through technology

raw.title: Complaints Officer - Graduate
raw.description:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

This role is for someone wanting to start a career in operations within a financial services firm. You'll join as a Graduate focused on working complaints and train to become a fully competent Complaints Officer, investigating and resolving our more complex customer interactions across loans, cards and auto-finance. A critical role to help the business understand how it can serve customers better.

This is a casework role. From early on you will hold your own caseload, speak to customers directly, make decisions on whether we got it right, and put things right where we didn't. You will be supported through structured training, coaching and quality feedback as you develop in the role

Some of the areas you'll delve into are:

  • The regulatory framework for complaints: FCA regulation, the DISP rules, Consumer Duty, and how the guidance is applied to real cases.

  • Investigation technique: gathering evidence, interrogating system records and call recordings, and testing what actually happened against what should have happened.

  • Decision making and redress: reaching fair and objective outcomes, and calculating and explaining any compensation due.

  • Customer communication: writing final response letters that break complex issues down into plain English.

  • The Financial Ombudsman Service: how cases are referred, how FOS reaches its view, and how we apply those learnings to future cases.

  • Root cause and feedback: spotting the product and process failures behind complaints and feeding them back to frontline and product teams.

Reporting to a Complaints Manager within the Operations Team, you will be responsible for a live caseload and for the quality of the decisions you make on it.

No prior complaints experience needed, we care about how you think, not what you already know. This role requires an ability to learn quickly, work to deadlines and support our customers effectively.

Your team's objectives

Lendable aims to resolve all complaints promptly, ensuring that they are investigated diligently and fairly for customers. We are committed to providing excellent customer service and to reaching the right outcomes for our customers.

Feedback is an important part of how we evolve as a business. The team is encouraged to speak up, take each complaint on its own merits and provide valuable insight back into the business so we can improve and grow.

Our ability to handle complaints effectively for our customers and therefore for us as a business has never been more important than now, as we expand our existing products in the UK and US financial markets.

What you'll be doing

  • Investigating and resolving complaints about our loans, cards and auto-finance products, taking each case on its own merits

  • Self-managing a varied and increasingly complex caseload: prioritising cases, choosing the best contact mechanism for each customer, and working efficiently enough to meet our KPI minimum standards

  • Communicating with complainants in writing and by phone — managing expectations, handling difficult situations with tact and professionalism, and finding solutions to the issues raised

  • Writing professional final response letters that set out our decision, our rationale and the customer's right to refer to the Financial Ombudsman Service

  • Following our complaint handling standards and keeping clear records, making sure every decision is backed by demonstrable evidence and a documented rationale

  • Working to resolve complaints without the customer needing to refer to FOS, and applying the learnings from both internal and FOS outcomes to future cases

  • Feeding back to frontline and product teams on the product and process improvements your cases surface, across Operations and the wider Lendable business

  • Keeping your knowledge of Lendable's products current through effective use and review of our policies, procedures and business tools

  • Turning your hand to other areas of operational need as the business requires

What we're looking for

  • Educated to degree level

  • Exceptional written communication - you can structure an argument and explain a complex decision clearly to someone who is not an expert

  • An aptitude for investigation, analysis, problem-solving and dispute resolution

  • Strong organisation and self-management - you can hold a caseload, prioritise it and work to deadlines without being chased

  • Sound judgment and a sound moral compass: willing to speak up to make sure good customer outcomes stay at the heart of what we do

  • Resilience and adaptability in a fast-paced, changing environment

  • A willingness to learn FCA regulation and the DISP complaint handling rules and guidance

The interview process

We're not a corporation so we try our best to get things moving as quickly as possible. For this role we'd expect:

  • A 15 minute cognitive assessment

  • A quick phone call with one of the Talent team

  • An onsite assessment centre with a role focus and a final stage interview with the Complaints Management team to discuss your fit and capability for the role.

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

Check out our blog!

We're hiring two Senior Quality Engineers to set up a Quality Engineering department at Lendable alongside a new Head of Quality.

At Lendable we already have a number of profitable, award winning credit products. They have a good automated quality story. However, as our customer base has grown into the millions we need to keep evolving to keep the quality bar high. Advances in AI engineering also have enabled us to ship faster, but we need to ensure we are not regressing on our quality metrics.

This is an automation-first role. You'll spend most of your time writing code - AI Agents, test frameworks, CI tooling, helpers. You won't be executing tests by hand. You'll work cross-functionally with software engineers, product and design. Quality is a team-level responsibility and your job is to work with teams to enable them to improve their quality processes by hands-on collaboration.

Enable teams to keep the quality bar high

title: Senior software engineer - EU squad
description: Hybrid working based at one of our offices in London, Bath or Edinburgh. Your contract will be hybrid, although we don’t currently require a set number of office days. We support flexible working and trust teams to agree how and where they work best, taking a pragmatic approach based on the needs of the role and team. About us Seccl is the Octopus-owned embedded investment platform, on a mission to help more people invest, and invest well. We’re building the infrastructure behind the next generation of investing. Our technology already powers some of the UK’s most ambitious fintechs, banks, financial advisers and wealth firms, with close to a million investors relying on Seccl-powered platforms. And we’re now expanding into Europe. We’ve got a proven product, strong momentum and big ambitions for what comes next: helping more household-name brands launch and scale investment propositions, entering new markets and replacing outdated investment infrastructure with technology that’s faster, simpler and built for scale. We’re proud to be part of Octopus, one of the UK’s most successful privately held investment and technology groups. That gives us the backing and long-term perspective to build something substantial, while keeping the pace and energy of a high-growth business. Seccl and Octopus are both B Corp certified and share a belief that profit and purpose should go hand in hand. If you want to help shape the future of investing in the UK and across Europe, you’ll be in good company. Check out the Seccl website to see what we’re building and read more about our mission to shape the future of investments. Our culture: Never settle – We think of ourselves as ‘embedded hero-makers’ for our customers. We put them first, and if we say we’ll do something, we’ll move heaven and earth to do it. We think boldly and embrace change. Take ownership - We think rigorously and deeply about a problem, but then charge at it, acting with and urgency and speed that sets us apart. But we never lose sight of quality or long-term scalability. Be generous & candid - We encourage our people – and our customers – to challenge us and never shy away from tough conversations. We have a flat and inclusive culture where everyone can be themselves – and speak up. Check out our Glassdoor page for the latest reviews or our LinkedIn for company updates and insights from the team. Our engineering ways of working: Our Product and Engineering organisation is structured into four tribes: Custody, Accounts, Experience, and Cloud & Security. Each tribe contains multiple autonomous squads, with clear full ownership over specific product domains. The squads are intentionally small and cross-functional, typically made up of an Engineering Manager, Product Manager, and 3–5 engineers with complementary skills aligned to the domain they own. We operate in a build-and-run model, with teams responsible for the full software lifecycle, from architecture and delivery through to operational support and incident management. Our core platform is built on AWS serverless technologies including Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, API Gateway, S3, and ECS. We primarily develop in TypeScript and Node.js, with MongoDB as our primary document database. We also have a small number of C# services and are continuing to evolve our platform architecture, including expanding our use of ECS Fargate. Infrastructure is managed through a combination of Terraform and Serverless Framework. We use GitHub Actions for CI/CD and incident.io to support our incident management processes and operational workflows. We care deeply about engineering quality, pragmatic architecture, and continuous improvement. If you’d like to go deeper, we’re happy to share more about our engineering practices and technology radar during the interview process. The role As an engineer at Seccl you will design, build and operate reliable and scalable, testable and maintainable software solutions, building new functionalities and products using Typescript and Node.js. You play a key role in our software development and have a hands-on approach throughout the development process supporting resilient financial workflow systems and regulated investment operations. As a senior member of the team, you are the ‘go-to’ person for queries. On a typical day you will… Work collaboratively in a domain aligned cross-functional squad made up of engineers and product along with colleagues from customer-facing and operations teams Design, implement and operate your services within your domain Be accountable for the SLAs of your products and iterative improvements Maintain and extend documentation for your services Foster a culture of continuous improvement and technical excellence while understanding when “good enough for now” is appropriate Provide guidance and mentorship for other engineers Communicate with non-technical colleagues to answer queries about the Seccl system What you need… To own your services from design to operation. We operate a build-and-run model where engineers have autonomy but full accountability. We care deeply about correctness, resilience and operational excellence because our systems underpin real customer investments. Engineers are not passengers in their products but champions. Drive improvements and features while collaborating openly with product, operations and engineering colleagues, challenging ideas constructively and focusing on delivering the best outcomes for customers. Have a strong ability to understand business and customer problems and turn them into efficient, scalable solutions. Be curious about how investment and custody products operate, and pragmatic in balancing customer value, operational correctness, engineering quality and long-term scalability. Experience building financial systems with multi-region, multi-currency or trading-related complexity would be advantageous. Experience in a strongly/statically typed language. Have a strong understanding of designing, building, and running high-quality, standards-compliant workflow APIs, with a focus on testing, observability, and performance. Have worked with a cloud provider (AWS/Azure/GCP). We use AWS. Have worked with distributed systems and are comfortable debugging through tracing and observability. Willing to be on-call for your services. Core technical skills you must have: Strong commercial experience with Node.js , specifically TypeScript Experience with Amazon Web Services Experience with Serverless products Experience with document databases, ideally MongoDB Experience mentoring engineers Experience leading technical delivery in a build-and-run engineering model Experience in a structured on-call process and incident management Experience working in regulated industries, ideally financial services or FinTech. This role isn’t for you if... You rely on a lot of top-down direction. Here, you’ll have a lot of freedom and ownership of your role, and you’ll be expected to shape your own progression, bring forward ideas, and spot opportunities to improve You’re not comfortable working in a fast-paced environment. Our speed and scalability are what set us apart; you need to be able to act quickly and think on your feet You struggle to follow through on ideas. We value people who do what they say they will. If you care about something, you have the freedom here to make it happen You don’t like change . You’ll get on great here if you relish the ambiguity of rapid growth and are willing to embrace uncertainty What’s in it for you… We offer a generous mix of benefits for the things that really matter to our people, including: Base salary based on experience and skills demonstrated during our assessment phase 🌴 27 days holiday + bank holidays (some can be flexible) + day off on your birthday + three days (full time) per year for Dependant leave 💙 Two volunteering days per year 🏅 Length of service award – one month paid sabbatical at eight years ✅ 6% employer pension contribution, and life assurance 🏥 Private medical insurance with AXA Health 👪 Enhanced Parental leave 💻 MacBook and up to £500 home office set up budget 📖 £750 per person learning budget 🌎 Option to work abroad for up to six weeks a year 🌻 Health and wellbeing initiatives including free therapy via Wellness Cloud, mental health support via Headspace 🌱 Strong financial wellbeing focus including access to Octopus Money , Octopus Share Incentive Plan and will writing offering via Octopus Legacy 🎁 Perkbox – Flexi-points giving you a range of discounts and perks including free weekly coffee, gym and retail discounts 🚲 Access to initiatives like Cycle to Work and Octopus Electric Vehicle Leasing Interview process Interviewing is a two-way thing, and we want you to have the time and opportunity to get to know us, as much as we are getting to know you. Our interviews are conversational, so come with questions and be curious. In general, you can expect the interview process to look a bit like this: Talent screen - 30 min intro call with our Talent partner or an Engineering manager Bar raiser - 40 min with two Engineering leaders Technical loop - 2h virtual technical assessment with 2 core components - system design and TypeScript code review with breaks between the stages. You will receive preparation materials for the round and more information on how to prepare. ⏳ We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out and you should expect to hear back from us within one to two weeks of applying. 🌈 Our aim is to build a diverse and inclusive company of awesome people, with unique skills, passions and experiences. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status. If this sounds like your kind of thing, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t tick every box. We’d love to hear from you! #LI-VS1 #LI-hybrid Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
